# Retained Q2 image interval

These files are exact copies of Q2 images 10 and 11, their capture metadata, and the recorded case result from the first native AUTHOR invocation. `provenance.json` binds each copied file to its original snapshot and SHA-256. The original native report remains INCONCLUSIVE; Q3–Q18 were not executed.

The adjacent images span the fresh R2 lifetime after W and R actually exited. The ending barrier remains `R2.exit`; it does not isolate exit as the operation that changed SHM. Tests load these bytes as inert buffers. Negative cases alter only in-memory copies or the supplied interval/prefix proof; they are reporting controls, not additional native observations. No SQLite connection opens these files.
